entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Aga and perused the record.

2.  This is the second bail application moved by the accused-applicant for grant of bail in Case Crime No.227 of 2021, under Section 363, 366, 376, 342, 120-B IPC & Section 3/4 POCSO Act, Police Station- Rampur Mathura, District- Sitapur, as his first bail application was rejected on 8.9.2022.
3.

While arguing the second bail application, counsel for the applicant argues that despite the fact that applicant is in custody since 30.06.2021, the trial is not proceeding, as such, the mandate of Section 35 (1) and 35 (2) are violated.

On perusal of the statement of the victim recorded under Prem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36209455/
1 Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., prima facie, it transpires that the victim had gone out of her own free will and she did not implicate the applicant for any offence.

entities.text: Prem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The tentative age of the victim is around 16 years, as per the family register, she is aged about 17 years, however, there is no formal process for adjudication adopted so far to finally determine the age of the victim.

4. Considering the two statements of the victim under Sections 161 and 164 Cr.P.C., coupled with the fact that applicant, who is in custody since 30.06.2021 and has no criminal history, is enlarged on bail.
6.
Thus the bail application is allowed.

7. Let the applicant Prem be released on bail in aforesaid first information report number subject to his furnishing a personal bond and two reliable sureties of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned with the following conditions:
(a) The applicant shall execute a bond to undertake to attend the hearings;
(b) The applicant shall not commit any offence similar to the offence of which he is accused or suspected of the commission; and (c) The applicant shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer or tamper with the evidence.
Order Date :- 15.4.2024 Gurpreet Singh  Prem vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home ... on 15 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36209455/
